limits.en: Development-version access only, 1 app editor, 6 hours of server logs, 50K workload units/month, includes API connector.

keyLimits.en: Development-version access only, 1 app editor, 50K workload units/month.
Live website with custom domain, 175K workload units/month, 5 mobile build submissions/month, 3 live app versions, basic version control, 2 days of server logs.
250K workload units/month, 2 app editors, 10 custom branches, premium version control with 2FA, 14 days of server logs, 10 mobile build submissions/month.
500K workload units/month, 5 app editors, 25 custom branches, 20 days of server logs, 20 mobile build submissions/month, sub-apps feature.
Custom workload, hosting location and build limits, dedicated support team, invoice/ACH payment options.

cautions.en: Pricing is measured in workload units (WU), a consumption metric representing server resources used, rather than a flat seat-based or usage-tier model, so real monthly cost depends on app complexity and traffic.
The Free plan only supports a development version; a live public website with a custom domain requires at least the Starter plan.

capabilities.en: No-code visual builder for creating full web applications with a database and custom business logic (workflows).
Native mobile app build/submission pipeline included on paid plans (5 to 20 submissions per month depending on tier).

limitations.en: Free plan cannot publish a live website with a custom domain, restricting it to development/prototyping use.
Cost scales with workload units consumed, which can be hard to predict in advance for a non-technical builder before launch.

reason.en: Broader web-building alternative, though more content-site oriented than full app logic.
No-code website builder competitor, though generally less suited to complex app logic than Bubble.
No-code/low-code app builder competitor with an open-source option.

missingAlternatives.reason: Direct no-code app-builder competitor, especially for mobile apps, not present in the catalogue.

missingAlternatives.reason: Major no-code web builder frequently compared to Bubble, absent from the catalogue.
